data.name: Stickys
data.detailed_description:
Stickys!
A fast-paced physics sandbox climber where you and up to 4 friends tackle massive levels packed with dynamic structures, movable objects, and limitless challenges begging to be conquered!

Inspired by Human Fall Flat, Gang Beasts, & Only Up! Grab walls, swing from beams, latch onto moving cranes, or even your friends. Knock them out, throw them off edges, climb on their backs, or team up for an epic cooperative climb. It's all in a vibrant 3D world where physics reigns supreme, but with quick, responsive controls for non-stop action.

Climb to the top by Sticking to anything (or Anyone!)
Overcome a variety of obstacles, shifting platforms, and physics-based challenges as you make your way to the very top. Every climb is an adventure of skill, timing and creativity! Use your sticky hands to grab, swing, and cling onto just about anything in the world, including your friends! 


Cooperate with friends in a physics based multiplayer experience!
Work together to reach new heights, our Sticky character is designed to be both easy to pick and endlessly fun to master. Enjoy smooth flexible movement that reacts naturally to the physics of the world around you. Team up or tangle up with up to 4 players in a chaotic, laugh-filled multiplayer experience.




Put your friendships to the test!
Unleash chaos by sending your friends flying! Cooperation is optional, but the laughter is guaranteed!
